description: Single source of truth for Emscripten EXPORTED_FUNCTIONS and EXPORTED_RUNTIME_METHODS. The only compile path is wasm_renderer/build.sh (npm run wasm:build); do not hand-copy the list. _main/_malloc/_free are Emscripten runtime symbols, not EMSCRIPTEN_KEEPALIVE.

exportsSchema.description: Per-export C signature and suspension policy. scripts/gen-wasm-exports-header.js turns it into the typed ccall wrappers (src/wasm/bridge/_generated.ts) and the C prototypes main.cpp includes (wasm_renderer/wasm_exports.h); verify:device-policy fails when either is stale or a main.cpp EMSCRIPTEN_KEEPALIVE signature drifts. Keys must be exportedFunctions minus runtimeOnlyExports.
exportsSchema.returns: void | int | float | string (C const char*, decoded by ccall)
exportsSchema.args: "name:type"; type is int | float | string (a JS string ccall copies onto the stack; C const char*) or a C pointer type ending in * (a caller-owned heap pointer, passed as a number)
exportsSchema.async: true when the call graph reaches wgpuInstanceWaitAny. Must equal wasm_compile_flags.json jspi.jspiExports. The bridge awaits it with { async: true } and runs async exports one at a time per module (src/wasm/bridge/call.ts).
exportsSchema.whileSuspended: sync exports only — what the bridge does when this export is called while an async export of the same module is suspended: call (plain CPU state; runs now) | queue (runs in order after the queued async work; must return void and take no pointer) | skip (dropped; returns 0/''/undefined — per-frame work the next frame redoes)
exportsSchema.optional: artifacts built before the export lack it; the wrapper returns null instead of calling

initWasmRenderer.note: Initialize → CreateDevice (adapter/device requests, error-scope pops) and CreateResources → TryCreateHistoryTexture.

shutdownWasmRenderer.note: Destroying the instance under a suspended WaitAny crashes the tab, so it runs after the in-flight call.

loadShader.note: Compute pipeline error-scope pop. The bridge keeps id/wgslCode allocated until the promise settles.

reloadShader.note: Same as loadShader; the old pipeline stays live until the new one compiles.

setActiveShader.note: Looks the id up in the pipeline map, so it must land after a queued loadShader of that id. Void: read slot 0 back to see whether it took.

updateUniforms.note: Render(): size-dependent textures are released while RecreateTextures is suspended; the next frame redoes it.

updateDepthMap.note: The bridge defers a depth map that arrives mid-suspend (runWhenIdle) on a copy of the data.

loadImageData.note: The bridge defers a still image that arrives mid-suspend (runWhenIdle) on a copy of the pixels.

loadImageExternal.note: 0 mid-suspend; the caller falls back to uploadImageData, which defers.

uploadVideoFrame.note: Per frame; a dropped frame is replaced by the next one.

beginFrameCapture.note: Encodes a copy from writeTexture_; captureFrame waits for idle first.
